text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Lake Shore Boulevard West, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending that U-turns be prohibited on Lakeshore Boulevard West, between Legion Road and a point 113 metres west. The proposed prohibition is intended to deter vehicles from making unsafe U-turns at the intersection of Lake Shore Boulevard West and Legion Road and west of the intersection.

City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit westbound U-turn movements at all times on Lake Shore Boulevard West, between Legion Road and a point 113 metres west.
